<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>3D Rotating Jenga Tower</title>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.9.0/p5.min.js"></script>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            background-color: white;
        }
        canvas {
            display: block;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        let w = 90;  // length of a Jenga block
        let d = 30;  // width of a Jenga block
        let h = 18;  // height of a Jenga block
        let rows = 18; // number of layers in the tower

        function setup() {
            createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight, WEBGL);
        }

        function draw() {
            background(255);
            
            // Add lighting for 3D effect
            ambientLight(150);
            directionalLight(255, 255, 255, 1, 1, -1);
            directionalLight(100, 100, 100, -1, -1, 1);
            
            // Allow mouse to control camera angle slightly, with auto-rotation
            let camX = map(mouseY, 0, height, PI/4, -PI/4);
            rotateX(camX - PI/8); // Base tilt
            rotateY(frameCount * 0.01); // Continuous rotation
            
            // Center the tower vertically
            translate(0, (rows * h) / 2 - h / 2, 0);
            
            fill(210, 180, 140); // Wood color
            stroke(139, 69, 19);
            strokeWeight(1);
            
            for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                push();
                translate(0, -i * h, 0); // Stack upwards
                
                if (i % 2 === 0) {
                    // Blocks aligned along Z axis, laid out along X axis
                    for (let j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
                        push();
                        translate(j * d, 0, 0);
                        box(d, h, w);
                        pop();
                    }
                } else {
                    // Blocks aligned along X axis, laid out along Z axis
                    for (let j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
                        push();
                        translate(0, 0, j * d);
                        box(w, h, d);
                        pop();
                    }
                }
                pop();
            }
        }

        function windowResized() {
            resizeCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
